title: Arcane Phantasm
summary: Arcane Phantasm is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a 45% chance to increase the Warframe's movement speed for a 18 seconds after successfully performing a melee block.
extract:
Arcane Phantasm is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a 45% chance to increase the Warframe's movement speed for a 18 seconds after successfully performing a melee block.
Can be sold for  500.

Effect

Acquisition
Awarded for killing or capturing the Eidolon Gantulyst.
Dropped in Rotation C of Orphix Pluto Proxima or Veil Proxima missions.
May appear as a Circuit Tier 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 9, or +11 reward on a weekly rotational basis.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.

visit here.

History
Arcane Phantasm was first introduced in the Trial mission The Law of Retribution, which was retired in Update 22.14 (2018-03-01).
The Operation: Scarlet Spear event sold Arcane Phantasm from Little Duck for 1,500  Scarlet Credits.
The Operation: Orphix Venom event sold Arcane Phantasm from Father for 300  Phasic Cells.
The Operation: Gargoyle's Cry event sold Arcane Phantasm from the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle for 5  Grotesque Splinter.
The Operation: Belly of the Beast event sold Arcane Phantasm from Ordis for 3  Volatile Motes in the first run of the event, and 4 Motes in the second, with a purchase limit of 42.
The Operation: Eight Claw event sold Arcane Phantasm from Dominus Thrax in bundles of 7, costing 2  Dominus Aureus, with a purchase limit of 3 (21 Arcanes in total).
